name: singlet_integration_unbalanced_batch_integration
title: Unbalanced and nested batch integration
description: Integrates batches whose cell-type composition differs, aligning each population only where it has cells in other batches and keeping batch-specific populations apart. The default scvi method trains a conditional VAE on raw counts with presence gates and writes a batch-free embedding, per-batch presence probabilities and over-correction flags; scanvi, stacas, seurat_cca, seurat_rpca, harmony, fastmnn, scanorama, liger and bbknn are comparators. Needs layers/counts, var/highly_variable, a batch column with at least two levels, and obsm/X_pca for PCA-based methods. Do not use it on one batch or to remove a condition that must be kept; use singlet_integration_integration_quality_scoring for full benchmark scores.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Integration method. scvi (default, with presence gates) is the proposed model; the others are comparators.

batch_key.description: obs column with the batch label; at least two levels. For nested designs, name the covariate to remove explicitly.

label_key.description: obs column with cell-type labels; required for scanvi and stacas, otherwise used for stratified diagnostics.

n_hvg.description: Number of var/highly_variable genes used as input.

n_pcs.description: PCs read from obsm/X_pca for PCA-based methods; ignored by scvi and scanvi.

scvi.description: Options for scvi and scanvi; presence_gates switches on the proposed gated objective.

n_latent.description: Latent dimension of the batch-free embedding.

n_hidden.description: Hidden units per layer of encoder and decoder.

n_layers.description: Hidden layers in encoder and decoder.

max_epochs.description: Training epochs; null lets the library choose from the cell count.

presence_gates.description: Apply presence gates to the alignment term; false gives the ungated baseline.

n_populations.description: Latent populations for the gates; null uses label levels, or Leiden clusters of the embedding.

diagnostics.description: Neighbourhood and label options for the metrics written to uns.

k_neighbors.description: Neighbours for kNN-based metrics such as graph connectivity and kSIM.

lisi_k0.description: Neighbourhood size for iLISI and cLISI.

cilisi_min_cells.description: Smallest cell type included in CiLISI.

kbet_k_max.description: Upper clip of the kBET neighbourhood size; the lower clip is 10.

seed.description: Random seed for initialisation, minibatches and neighbour search; recorded with the output.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running or writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members of this method instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/X_integrated_scvi. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, presence_gates, batch_key, n_batches, n_populations, n_cells, n_hvg_used, n_pcs, device, seed, warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
